image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) perched among dry, leafless branches against a pale, overcast sky. The bird displays glossy black plumage with visible iridescence on the neck, prominent red eyebrow combs, and a short dark beak. Its body is robust, and it sits in a characteristic upright posture. The tail appears to have the beginning of a lyre shape, though partially obscured by twigs. Legs are not clearly visible due to occlusion by branches and body angle.
